title: Comparing Optimization Models for Radiotherapy Scheduling
summary: The Radiotherapy Scheduling Problem (RTSP) involves determining an optimal schedule for patients undergoing radiation treatments, a task that has a massive impact on clinical outcomes given the central role of radiotherapy in cancer care. The daily batch approach--which consists of scheduling all the newly arrived patients together at the end of each day--modelled with Integer Linear Programming, is currently one of the most effective methods for the RTSP. However, this kind of formulation requires substantial computational resources in terms of time and memory. Here, we address these…
